subject.title: fix(tlon): account checks leave streaming responses open

question: Should the Tlon owner accept cancellation of an unread account-probe response body before guarded-dispatcher release as the canonical lifecycle ordering for this probe?
rationale: The implementation and real-path proof are strong, but this decision establishes the owner-level response/dispatcher lifecycle contract for a channel network path.

options.title: Accept the owner-local cleanup ordering
options.body: Approve the current narrow change because it matches the existing Tlon pattern and closes unread streaming probe responses before dispatcher release.

options.title: Choose a different shared lifecycle contract
options.body: Request a scoped redesign only if Tlon should centralize unread-response disposal rather than keep it at each caller that intentionally does not consume a body.

recommendation.title: Accept the owner-local cleanup ordering
recommendation.body: Approve the current narrow change because it matches the existing Tlon pattern and closes unread streaming probe responses before dispatcher release.
